A Norwegian church christening record was searched in old parish books covering Ringsaker, in the Hedmark region of Norway, to find out who Anders Moen's parents were. The record was not found under the family's farm name "Moen," because Norwegian church registers of this era commonly recorded children under their father's given name instead — so the search was rerun under "Hansen" (since the father was named Hans). That brought up a single clear result: the christening entry for Anders, son of Hans Olsen and Marit Pedersdatter, dated 15 November 1868 in Ringsaker — entirely consistent with the October 1868 birth estimate, since the date in the register is the christening date rather than the birth date. Both parent names, Hans and Marit, match what US records had suggested.

Next, the christening record will be formally extracted into the research project as a sourced, cited piece of evidence confirming Anders Moen's parentage.
